header.running_head: The Practices of Nabi ﷺ and the Sahabah (RA) with Regard to Clothing

blocks.text: one who remarked, 'If only they had preserved the rooms without demolishing them so that (by seeing them) people would reduce their building endeavours and see what Allaah preferred for His Nabi ﷺ even though He possessed the keys to the treasures of the world.'" [^1]
